blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum aham computational structures (data ko rakhne aur sambhalne ke tareeqe) dekhenge: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs. Yeh programming ki buniyad hain. Hum in ki properties (khasusiyat), operations (in par kiye jane wale kaam) aur inhein efficiently (kam waqt aur kam mehnat mein) banane ka tareeqa parhenge. Phir hum dekhenge ke kisi masle ke liye sahi structure kaise chunte hain, aur asal zindagi mein in ka istemal kaise hota hai. Chapter ke aakhir tak aap in structures ko mukhtalif jagahon par sahi tarah istemal karna seekh lenge.

Rozmarra zindagi mein hum aksar data ko tarteeb se rakhte aur sambhalte hain. Maslan phone mein contacts save karna, karne wale kaamon ki to-do list banana, ya kitchen mein plates ek ke oopar ek rakhna. Isi tarah computer ko bhi data tarteeb se rakhna aur sambhalna hota hai. Computational structures is kaam mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Har rozmarra misal ko us structure se milaiye: to-do list, plates ka dher, bank ki qataar.
blocks.explanation: To-do list: list; plates ka dher: stack; bank ki qataar: queue.

items: Computational structures data ko tarteeb se rakhte hain: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs.
